title: Post-architecture clean evaluation
purpose: Measure whether the capability contract, preflight, evidence states, budget accounting and failure-repeat detection changed the RELIABILITY and SCIENTIFIC DISCIPLINE of the agent. This is deliberately NOT an independent-discovery evaluation.
why_not_an_autonomy_level_test: The agent's research memory and the menu's dead-end notes both contain measured teacher outcomes, verified by audit before this run: 5 answer-shaped hits in research memory and 21 in dead_ends.
That content is legitimate accumulated knowledge and is what makes the agent effective in normal operation, so it is NOT removed for this evaluation.
But it steers attention, so no result here can support a Level A claim. The autonomy classification remains Level B (capability transfer) and this protocol does not attempt to move it.
why_identical: The before/after reliability comparison is only meaningful at the same budget and settings as the pre-architecture evaluation.

primary_metrics.preflight_catches: scripts rejected before execution, by stage
primary_metrics.orchestration_only_misuse: attempts to call an orchestration-only capability from generated code. Pre-architecture these cost 3 full iterations; now they must cost zero training time.
primary_metrics.experiment_completion_rate: scored experiments / iterations that consumed budget
primary_metrics.repeated_identical_failures: same failure fingerprint twice in a run

scientific_discipline_metrics.single_seed_claims_promoted: results treated as established on one seed. Target: 0.
scientific_discipline_metrics.confirmation_triggered: did a promising single-seed result cause a confirmation experiment
scientific_discipline_metrics.inquiry_completeness: share of nodes stating observation, >=2 hypotheses, discriminating measurement, capability_required and promotion_criterion
scientific_discipline_metrics.capability_named_correctly: share of stated capability_required values that exist in the contract and are valid in the chosen context

success_criteria_fixed_in_advance.primary: Path B crash rate strictly below the pre-architecture 0.71, with zero training time spent on orchestration-only misuse.
success_criteria_fixed_in_advance.secondary: No single-seed result promoted to a confirmed claim or carried forward as settled.
success_criteria_fixed_in_advance.tertiary: Preflight rejections cost no training time and are accounted separately from experiments.
success_criteria_fixed_in_advance.explicitly_not_a_criterion: Beating 0.60541. The benchmark has plateaued; a score change is not what this protocol is testing, and the incumbent is protected.

aborted_attempts_disclosed.outcome: stopped by the operator during run 1
aborted_attempts_disclosed.reason: Discovered that --fresh was archiving logs/research_memory.jsonl, so the research-memory subsystem was inert in the very runs meant to evaluate it.
aborted_attempts_disclosed.action: fixed run_agent.SUBMISSION_ARTIFACTS, added a regression test, restarted the whole protocol from run 1

aborted_attempts_disclosed.reason: ENVIRONMENT FAULT CAUSED BY THE OPERATOR, not agent behaviour. The kill that ended attempt 1 interrupted executor.restricted_access, which chmods protected paths read-only for the duration of a subprocess. config/ and agent/experience.md were left read-only, and the agent aborted when it tried to write its experience notes.
aborted_attempts_disclosed.results_examined_before_stopping: run 1's metrics were computed and showed 1 node; the run had crashed on the environment fault, so no behavioural conclusion was drawn from it
aborted_attempts_disclosed.action: restored permissions, made restricted_access restore on SIGTERM, made the experience write non-fatal, restarted the whole protocol from run 1

restart_integrity_note: No attempt was abandoned because its results were unfavourable. Both aborts were defects in the harness or the environment, found and fixed rather than worked around. The reported evaluation is the first attempt to run to completion, and all three of its runs are reported.
environment_frozen_at: commit recorded in each run's provenance stamp
incumbent_protection: verify_incumbent must recompute 0.60541 exactly, before and after.
